Tamo upoznaje Loren, vlasnicu lokalnog bara, koja mu pomaže da shvati da je život mnogo više od puke jurnjave za slavom i bogatstvom.

programme.title: Šta sve činimo zbog ljubavi
programme.desc: Ambiciozna Sofi napušta mali posrednički biro i prelazi u prestižnu firmu Floating Lotus na Menhetnu. Kao pomoćni posrednik brzo ulazi u sukob sa harizmatičnim Džejsonom Šarpom, sinom vlasnika i kompanijinim lajf koučem. Ipak, njih dvoje primorani su da rade zajedno.

programme.title: Tomiris
programme.desc: Tomiris, kraljica Amazonki, povela je 600 godina pre nove ere krvavi rat protiv Persijskog carstva. Kada persijski kralj Kir uništi njeno selo, ona okuplja ogromnu vojsku da oslobodi svoj narod. Slede spektakularne bitke, borbe na život i smrt i spletke surovog kralja koji silom i prevarama želi da pokori narod.

programme.title: Premijera
programme.desc: Film je u celosti smešten u večeri u kojoj se odvija premijerno izvođenje srednjoškolske postavke Šekspirovog "Sna letnje noći". Film "Premijera" je hronika katastrofalnih dešavanja na sceni, kao i drame koju iza scene preživljavaju neki od učenika, njihov profesor književnosti i gostujuća zvezda B produkcije.

programme.title: Dženino venčanje
programme.desc: U gradiću u kom je rođena, niko ne shvata zašto se Dženi, najlepša i najpopularnija devojka iz kraja, još uvek nije udala. Kruže glasine da je ljubavnica oženjenog muškarca u "velikom gradu" u kom sada živi, zbog čega nikoga ne dovodi sa sobom na venčanje svog školskog druga. Njeni roditelji očajnički žele da se skrasi. Ipak, Dženina objava venčanja, kada do toga konačno dođe, nije ono što je bilo ko od njih očekivao.

programme.title: Deset stvari koje bi trebalo da uradimo pre raskida
programme.desc: Kada Ebigejl, samohrana majka dvoje dece, zatrudni nakon jedne noći provedene s Benom, ovaj neobični par pokušaće da se izbori s novonastalom situacijom.

programme.title: Pustinjski plen
programme.desc: Mlada botaničarka dolazi u mali pustinjski grad kako bi proučavala invazivnu biljnu vrstu. Nakon pada aviona, zarobljava je neiskusni kurir droge i primorava da ga vodi kroz surovu pustinju. Dok šerif traga za njima, njegova buntovna ćerka kreće u potragu za nestalom naučnicom.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: Han Dong-su priprema odbranu svoje supruge Hje-jong, ali situacija dobija neočekivan obrt kada So Do-jong ponudi pomoć.

programme.title: She Shoulda Said No
programme.desc: A chorus girl's career is ruined and her brother is driven to suicide when she starts smoking marijuana.

programme.title: Indiscreet
programme.desc: A young woman jeopardizes the relationship with the man she loves when a no-account from her past shows up.

programme.title: Gregoire
programme.desc: Loosely based on real life events, Gregoire follows four young adults and the choices they make when put at a crossroads of their life. As they struggle to make choices, their paths cross with one another and their choices affect not only themselves, but their friends, and their families.

programme.title: Following Nazarin
programme.desc: A journey through memory accompanied by Buñuel's photographs taken during the scouting of locations for "Nazarín", as well as the ones made by Manuel Álvarez Bravo during the shooting of the film, along with the testimonies and reflections of artists, filmmakers and intellectuals like Luis Eduardo Aute, Jean Claude Carrière, Carlos Reygadas, Silvia Pinal, Arturo Ripsetein or Carlos Saura among many others, to re-discover the poetic, vivid and inspiring force of Buñuel's cinematography.

programme.title: 'Neath the Arizona Skies
programme.desc: Chris Morrell, the guardian of half-Indian girl Nina, is helping her find her missing white father. so she can cash in on her late mother's oil lease. Outlaw Sam Black is after the girl and her father as well. Besides dealing with the Black gang, Morrell has to find another robber, Jim Moore, who switches clothes with him after he finds Chris unconscious from a fight with Sam Black. Along the way, he meets a lady who's the sister of Jim Moore, another bad hombre who's in cahoots with Jim Moore, and an old friend who takes in Nina and helps Chris locate Nina's father and fight off the various desperadoes

programme.title: When a Dream Comes True
programme.desc: Ed decides to leave his life in Barcelona to take a trip to the United States to follow his childhood dream of becoming a filmmaker there. Close to turning 40, and with his wedding just around the corner, he realizes that his life has not worked out as he had planned. An identity crisis begins which makes him leave everything and try to make his childhood dream —the American dream— come true. With the script of a film he wrote a few years ago under his arm, and the idea of trying to make the project a reality in the United States, Ed embarks on a road trip from New York to Hollywood, on which he meets diverse characters with whom he reflects upon the pros and cons of following our dreams, while at the same time he tries to achieve his and seeks a more precise definition of happiness.

programme.title: The Strange Woman
programme.desc: In early 19th century New England, an attractive unscrupulous woman uses her beauty and wits to deceive and control the men around her.

programme.title: Africa Screams
programme.desc: When bookseller Buzz cons Diana into thinking that his friend Stanley knows all there is to know about Africa, they are abducted and ordered to lead Diana and her henchmen to an African tribe in search of a fortune in jewels.

programme.title: Roaring Abyss
programme.desc: A sound journey accros the mountains, deserts and forests of Ethiopia and its cultural universe. Roaring Abyss will take you through an inedit collection of music recordings of unvaluable importance for the transmission and preservation of the African heritage.

programme.title: Dressed to Kill
programme.desc: A convicted thief in Dartmoor prison hides the location of the stolen Bank of England printing plates inside three music boxes. When the innocent purchasers of the boxes start to be murdered, Holmes and Watson investigate.

programme.title: Parlor, Bedroom and Bath
programme.desc: Jeffrey Haywood wants to marry to Virginia Embrey. However, Virginia refused to marry unless her older sister, the hard-to-please Angelica gets married first. Angelica, in turn, finds every man she knows too dull and predictable, and for this reason prefers to stay single. Jeff then tries to make Angelica interested in the mild-mannered and timid Reggie Irving passing him off as a notorious playboy to intrigue her. He asks his friend Polly to teach Reggie "how to treat a woman right", but he turns to be a disastrous learner.

programme.title: Doll Face
programme.desc: Burlesque queen Doll Face Carroll is dismissed from an audition for a legitimate Broadway show because she lacks culture. Her boss/manager Mike decides that she can get both culture and plenty of publicity by writing her autobiography. He hires a ghost writer to do all the work, but doesn't count on the possibility that Doll Face and her collaborator might have more than a book on their minds.

programme.title: Went the Day Well?
programme.desc: The quiet village of Bramley End is taken over by German troops posing as Royal Engineers. Their task is to disrupt England's radar network in preparation for a full scale German invasion. Once the villagers discover the true identity of the troops, they do whatever they can to thwart the Nazis plans.

programme.title: The Smallest Show on Earth
programme.desc: Jean and Bill are a married couple trying to scrape a living. Out of the blue they receive a telegram informing them Bill's long-lost uncle has died and left them his business—a cinema in the town of Sloughborough. Unfortunately they can't sell it for the fortune they hoped as they discover it is falling down and almost worthless.

programme.title: The Mystery of Mr. Wong
programme.desc: Detective James Lee Wong must find the "Eye of the Daughter of the Moon," a priceless but cursed sapphire stolen in China and smuggled to America. His search takes him into the heart of Chinatown and to the dreaded "House of Hate" to find the deadly gem before it can kill again.

programme.title: The Overlanders
programme.desc: It's the start of WWII in Northern Australia. The Japanese are getting close. People are evacuating and burning everything in a "scorched earth" policy. Rather than kill all their cattle, a disparate group decides to drive them overland half way across the continent, from Wyndham in Western Australia through the Northern Territory outback of Australia to pastures north of Brisbane, Queensland.

programme.title: New Voices in an Old Flower
programme.desc: "It was an era, it was the start of a new vision" says Amha Eshete, the first Ethiopian music producer back in the Golden Age, the days of Swingin' Addis. The album releases that have crossed Ethiopian borders are mainly recordings from the 50's to the 80's, however, the contemporary music scene from Addis remains, bar a few exceptions, unknown to the rest of the world. Is Addis still swinging as it used to? Music in Addis is present in actions and sounds spread out on differentiated spaces, it is an expression of the everyday urban life and its processes of transformation and adaptation in the city. New Voices In An Old Flower explores this vitality of music looking at the plurality of the city and its people. Drifting in unplanned tours through the urban landscape of contemporary Addis Ababa, this film is shaped by encounters, dialogues and collaborations with musicians and other inhabitants of the city.

programme.title: Revenge of the Zombies
programme.desc: When Dr. Von Altermann's wife Lila dies mysteriously at his spooky mansion her relations suspect murder. They also suspect the doctor is turning her into a zombie, to join the army of living dead he hopes to devote to the Nazi cause. However, Lila, though dead, has developed a will of her own.

programme.title: The Fatal Hour
programme.desc: When a police officer is murdered, Captain Street looks to Mr. Wong to catch the killer. Prime Suspect: Frank Belden Jr., whose father is a businessman well known for both his success and dishonesty. Mr. Wong faces increasing danger and is nearly executed himself as the investigation develops in treachery and complexity. As Mr. Wong follows the trail of dead bodies, he uncovers a jewel smuggling ring on the San Francisco waterfront and a case much larger than the death of a police officer.

programme.title: The Fatal Hour
programme.desc: When a police officer is murdered, Captain Street looks to Mr. Wong to catch the killer. Prime Suspect: Frank Belden Jr., whose father is a businessman well known for both his success and dishonesty. Mr. Wong faces increasing danger and is nearly executed himself as the investigation develops in treachery and complexity. As Mr. Wong follows the trail of dead bodies, he uncovers a jewel smuggling ring on the San Francisco waterfront and a case much larger than the death of a police officer.

programme.title: In Old Mexico
programme.desc: Escaped criminal "The Fox" hates Hoppy and a Rurales colonel for imprisoning him and lures Cassidy to Mexico in order to exact his vengeance.

programme.title: The Painted Desert
programme.desc: Western pardners Jeff and Cash find a baby boy in an otherwise deserted emigrants' camp, and clash over which is to be "father." They are still bitterly feuding years later when they own adjacent ranches. Bill, the foundling whom Cash has raised to young manhood, wants to end the feud and extends an olive branch toward Jeff, who now has a lovely daughter. But during a mining venture, the bitterness escalates. Is Bill to be set against his own adoptive father?

programme.title: Sleepless
programme.desc: Count Karl Ulysses von Salis-Marschlins was a Swiss botanist and naturalist. He travelled widely observing and studying the lands he visited. In 1789 he travelled in the Kingdom of Naples. On returning home, he wrote a book about it. Here is how he described his visit to the "Casino del Duca" at San Basilio, the largest estate of Apulia, South Italy. "Anapeson" are these places, now, sleepless and abandoned within the distracted modernity. The History as ruins.

programme.title: The Frontiersmen
programme.desc: The local school is causing Hoppy problems. First Bar 20 cattle are stolen when Hoppy investigates a problem there. Then the new teacher arrives and disrupts the routine of the Bar 20 hands. Later with the Bar 20 hands at graduation, the rustlers are poised to strike again. But there is dissension among them and this will lead to the break that Hoppy needs.

programme.title: Wake Me When the War Is Over
programme.desc: During the final months of WW2, a lonely German Baroness hides an attractive American airman in her mansion for long time without telling him the war has been over for almost five years.

programme.title: Schengen
programme.desc: In one Paris divided militarily into two like was the former Berlin Est-Ouest, Ines Raymond receives from the right bank people who ask for a visa for the left bank. Each have their reasons and dreams for crossing the Seine, but, Ines must follow the new instructions.

programme.title: My Favourite Brunette
programme.desc: Ronnie Jackson is a lowly baby photographer who secretly fantasizes about being a private detective. When a lovely baroness actually mistakes him for one and asks him to help locate her missing husband, Baron Montay, Ronnie finds himself agreeing. Several days later he is on death row whiling away the hours until his execution by recounting to a group of reporters the bizarre tale of how he ended up there.

programme.title: Too Late for Tears
programme.desc: Through a fluke circumstance, a ruthless woman stumbles across a suitcase filled with $60,000, and is determined to hold onto it even if it means murder.

programme.title: My Dear Secretary
programme.desc: A budding young writer thinks it's her lucky day when she is chosen to be the new secretary for Owen Waterbury, famous novelist. She is soon disppointed, however, when he turns out to be an erratic, immature playboy. Opposites attract, of course, but not without sub-plots that touch on competitiveness within marriage and responsibility.

programme.title: The Passionate Plumber
programme.desc: Paris plumber Elmer Tuttle is enlisted by socialite Patricia Alden to help make her lover Tony Lagorce jealous. With the help of his friend Julius J. McCracken and through the high society contacts he has made through Patricia, Elmer hopes to find financing for his latest invention, a pistol with a range-finding light. Comic complications ensue when Elmer's effort to interest a military leader is misconstrued as an assassination attempt.

programme.title: The Plague at the Karatas Village
programme.desc: A new mayor comes to the remote village Karatas. A very strange illness reins over here. However somebody is used to live with it and says this is a simple flu.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: A Confederate veteran living in the Yankee North struggles with his son's shock induced muteness and the hate of the Northerners.

programme.title: Christmas Wish
programme.desc: A little squirrel with lots of charm accidentally helps two poor, down-but-NOT-out families overcome their obstacles.

programme.title: Bluebeard
programme.desc: Young female models are being strangled. Will law enforcement be able to stop the crime wave before more women become victims?

programme.title: The Fabulous Dorseys
programme.desc: The rise and rise of the Fabulous Dorsey brothers is charted in this whimsical step down memory lane, Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey play themselves in this vehicle for their excellent music.

programme.title: Daughters, Wives and a Mother
programme.desc: Tashiro coincidentally meets his best friend Sugimoto in a bar very close to the apartment in which Sugimoto's wayward wife is found dead. Although Tashiro is not a suspect in the police investigation, he is racked with guilt and confesses to his wife, Masako. In an effort to further relieve his tortured sense of guilt, he then confesses to Sugimoto. Neither his wife nor his friend can believe that he could have been involved.

programme.title: Delightfully Dangerous
programme.desc: Young Sherry Williams dreams of having a singing career, and she idolizes her older sister Josephine, who has gone to New York to perform on the stage. When Sherry is distraught just before performing at her school, a visiting Broadway producer encourages her by telling her positive things about her sister. Soon afterwards, Sherry decides to make a surprise trip to New York to visit Josephine _ but what she finds there is not at all what she expected.

programme.title: Jack London
programme.desc: Episodes in adventurous life of the American novelist.

programme.title: Carnival of Souls
programme.desc: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past.

programme.title: Tokyo Twilight
programme.desc: Two sisters find out the existence of their long-lost mother, but the younger cannot take the truth of being abandoned as a child.

programme.title: One Body Too Many
programme.desc: An insurance salesman arrives at a creepy mansion to discover his potential eccentric millionaire client already dead. Instead he gets embroiled in a house full of greedy, murderous relatives competing for the inheritance.

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: Buck Colins heads a group of local ranchers who are trying to prevent the railroad from completing its line through their property. Till now they have been able to charge tolls on herds passing through. Hoppy goes undercover to expose them.

programme.title: Inertial Love
programme.desc: The relationship between Javier and Anna runs out of gas. She hits the brakes and Javier is dragged by inertia until he learns to get over it.

programme.title: People Are Funny
programme.desc: A comedy based on NBC's "People Are Funny" radio (and later television) program with Art Linkletter with a fictional story of how the program came to be on a national network from its humble beginning at a Nevada radio station. Jack Haley is a producer with only half-rights to the program while Ozzie Nelson and Helen Walker are the radio writers and supply the romance. Rudy Vallee, always able to burlesque himself intentional and, quite often, unintentional, is the owner of the sought-after sponsoring company. Frances Langford, as herself, sings "I'm in the Mood for Love" while the Vagabonds quartet (billed 12th and last) chimes in on "Angeline" and "The Old Square Dance is Back Again."

programme.title: My Man Godfrey
programme.desc: Fifth Avenue socialite Irene Bullock needs a "forgotten man" to win a scavenger hunt, and no one is more forgotten than Godfrey Park, who resides in a dump by the East River. Irene hires Godfrey as a servant for her riotously unhinged family, to the chagrin of her spoiled sister, Cornelia, who tries her best to get Godfrey fired. As Irene falls for her new butler, Godfrey turns the tables and teaches the frivolous Bullocks a lesson or two.

programme.title: The Amazing Adventure
programme.desc: A bored millionaire wagers his doctor that he can support himself at a working class job for year without touching his inheritance.

programme.title: Talea
programme.desc: Summertime. Everybody is excited to go on vacation to Italy. Everybody but Jasmin. Jasmin is yearning something. She wants to be with Eva, her mother, from whom she had to live seperately for a long time. For weeks, Jasmin is trying to get close to Eva. She does not give up, even if she's rejected. After an argument, Jasmin runs away from her fosterhome and convinces Eva to leave the city together and go on a trip. The two get closer -- sometimes as friends, sometimes as mother and daughter. A first joint cigarette, a dance in the village disco, wanderings through the woods. But expectations and needs of the girl and her mother are diverging repeatedly, especially when a man attracts Eva's attention and disturbs the growing closeness between mother and daughter.

programme.title: A Farewell to Arms
programme.desc: A ravishing adaptation of Ernest Hemingway's legendary novel, A FAREWELL TO ARMS stars Gary Cooper as Lt. Frederic Henry, a young ambulance driver for the Italian army in WWI, more interested in chasing women than the enemy. When seeking cover during an air raid, he encounters Nurse Catherine Barkley, and the world shifts under his feet. They fall in love, but the war keeps wrenching them apart. These painful separations force Frederic to choose between love and battle, a decision that tests him morally and spiritually, and leads to one of the most rapturously romantic endings of all time.

programme.title: Operation Bottleneck
programme.desc: WW II Burma...Six paratroopers undertake an extremely dangerous mission against the Japanese. It will ultimately cost them their lives, except for one "lucky" survivor.

programme.title: Speak Easily
programme.desc: A timid professor inherits a large sum of money and decides to fund a terrible musical.

programme.title: Impact
programme.desc: A unfaithful wife plots with her lover to kill her husband, but the lover is accidentally killed instead. The husband stays in hiding and lets his wife be charged with conspiracy.

programme.title: The Southerner
programme.desc: Sam Tucker, a cotton picker, in search of a better future for his family, decides to grow his own cotton crop. In the first year, the Tuckers battle disease, a flood, and a jealous neighbor. Can they make it as farmers?

programme.title: Stingaree
programme.desc: A young lady named Hilda who works as a servant for the wealthy Clarksons, sheep farmers, and dreams of being a great singer. An upcoming visit by Sir Julian, a famous composer arriving from London, drives jealous Mrs. Clarkson (an interfering biddy who fancies she can sing _ but can't) to send away Hilda, so he doesn't hear Hilda has a good voice. Meanwhile, an infamous outlaw named Stingaree has just arrived in town and kidnaps Sir Julian, then poses as him at the Clarksons, where he meets Hilda a few hours before she is to leave.

When it is discovered that the plunge was not an accident, the building's residents come under suspicion. Soon, the body count begins to mount as three more murders occur by strangulation.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: Investigators try new techniques and encounter more odd activities throughout this large estate.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We've got our own private Idaho in Boise. We'll tour one of the most stunning buildings in the frontier west at the Idaho State Capitol, dance all night with the Basques at the Basque museum and cultural center, soar to new heights at the Warhawk Air Museum in Nampa, and get a shiver down our spines at the Idaho state penitentiary.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: In this episode we visit the Kennedy Space Center located on Florida's famous "Space Coast." We'll speak to NASA engineers about the past, present and future of American space travel, as well as take a look at the attractions KSC has to offer.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Trolling coho at Calvert Island and on a big Chinook Salmon quest Southbound around Cape Caution and Port Hardy!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Music Voyager

The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Join us as we discover the amazing history of this ancient city through its religion, royal lineage, architecture and art. In the markets, Bill shows you how to buy souvenirs like a pro. We visit the Golconda Fort where the ultimate in diamond souvenirs originated. And, of course, no visit to Hyderabad would be complete without taking a look at its high-tech and movie industries, which have revolutionized the city.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: No city in the Great Thar Desert of West India has had the sway that Jodhpur has. Giant forts, impressive palaces and a legendary royal hero that frees his people from tyrannical outsiders all make this a fascinating historic romp.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: The Great Rift Valley is actually where the continent of Africa is literally tearing itself apart. It's a geologic phenomenon where one side is a rainforest full of colorful birds and strange monkeys and the other, a large lake centered on a vast plain. Two bordering eco-zones…double the wildlife.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: If it's rhinos you want to see, you must visit Hluhluwe-Imfolozi Wildlife Park. This huge wilderness area has the highest density of rhino in the world. In addition to the rhino, we locate a pride of lions that is truly amazing. Mkuze National Park is a treasure trove of rare antelope and various other big game. Best of all, there is often no other guests, so this is one of Africa's best hidden gems.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Athletes from across the world are competing in skier cross and big mountain freeskiing for pride glory and big bucks.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Behind the scenes of a mountain bike action movie with the top riders in the world hitting new stunts and tricks that will elevate the sport of freeride mountain biking.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: The tiny island nation of Tonga in the remote South Pacific is a haven for the magnificent mammals. With few natural resources or other means of income, the country is considering opening it's waters to foreign whaling fleets in exchange for hard currency. The merits and legitimacy of scientific whaling by Japan and other nations is hotly debated. The iconic species is a favorite of whale watchers from Alaska to Mexico and the stage is set for an epic battle between whalers and conservationists. Humpbacks: From Tonga to Antarctica also features Paul Watson of the Sea Shepherd Society.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan joins an expedition to recruit a new Blue World camera operator in the form of a 1,000 pound Tiger shark! Working with experienced shark handlers, he puts a camera on the dorsal fin of the shark to see what it can film all by itself. But will Jonathan get his camera back? Next, he joins an experienced cave diver to explore a famous underwater cave in Northern Florida (USA).

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Cave diving is the most difficult and dangerous type of diving, so the training to become a certified cave diver is arduous. This episode documents Jonathan's actual cave training in the Bahamas and follows him as he learns how to dive safely in the overhead environment of a cave in an attempt to earn his full cave diver certification.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Posse the red panda and Santiago the saki have been having issues with their teeth. The dentist has arrived but he's got some good news and bad news. The good news is neither of them have to foot the bill. The bad news is, he's brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process? Loro Parque reports from the Bolivian front line and the front row of the local fashion parade!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: For over a year, the staff at Loro Parque have been patiently waiting for a huge event to take place. Morgan, the deaf orca is about to give birth to her very first calf. The stakes are high, and the staff are holding their collective breath as the scene is set for the greatest natural phenomenon in the zoo's history.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Fanged Spiders with their scurrying bites. The Scorpion with its deadly sting... A sinister cold bloodied crocodile. The hypnotizing venomous snake. Or the King of Beasts, the Lion? Which one is the most dangerous? Lion _ With golden fur and regal mane, the lion reigns as the 'King of Beasts'. Scorpions _ In scorched deserts, danger awakens after sunset. Spiders _ Masters of webs and venom, spiders haunt myth and imagination. Snakes _ Feared and revered, snakes symbolize power, death, and rebirth. Crocodile _ Ancient and deadly, crocodiles inspire fear and legend across the globe.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The charming kangaroo. The cuddly koala. The beautiful Butterfly. The cheerful clown fish. Or the endearing budgerigar _ which is the cutest of them all? Clownfish _ Tropical oceans shimmer with dazzling marine life like the vibrant clownfish. Kangaroo _ Australia's countryside pulses with thousands of bounding kangaroos. Monarch Butterfly _ Monarchs fill the skies, delicate and stunning in flight. Budgerigar _ Social and lively, wild budgies flock in hundreds across Australia. Koala _ Soft-furred and beloved, koalas are one of Australia's most iconic animals.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: In nature, both males and females fight fiercely—especially females defending their young. Most battles occur within the same species over food, territory, status, or mates. While not always fatal, these fights can lead to death. Animals protect food sources directly or by defending territory rich in prey. This territorial aggression helps distribute populations but can also limit them—like wolves starving without territory. Though fighting can secure survival, it comes at a cost: injury, exhaustion, and death. Often, avoiding conflict is the wisest strategy.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Prey must constantly avoid predators, and any defensive adaptation boosts survival. Speed is a key defense—antelope are built to run, chased by sprinters like cheetahs. Over time, predators evolved to be fast, and prey evolved to be faster. Antelope also travel long distances for food. Ostriches, though flightless, are the fastest-running birds. The Golden Wheel spider escapes danger by turning into a rolling wheel. In the Race of Life, survival depends on clever, sometimes surprising adaptations.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Killer armies collaborate to take down larger prey. On land, a zebra's kick can kill, but in the water it's easy meat for a congregation of crocodiles. Wild dogs may not seem like fearsome predators, but a pack kills fast, brutally and often.

programme.title: Creative Killers
programme.desc: Savuti is big cat country, where only the most resourceful predators thrive. This film follows three characters through winter as small game vanishes and buffalo arrive. The Marsh Pride faces tough terrain and rival lions, while Saba, the matriarch, struggles after a hyena attack. A lone female leopard adapts her hunting strategy to survive in a lion-dominated landscape. Through nighttime hunts and clever use of terrain, these predators battle Savuti's harsh conditions and each other.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: In the forest's dark underworld, there's a lot more happening than meets the eye. Under every rock, behind every tree, death could be lurking.Africa's largest cobra is beat to the chase by the Giant bullfrog. Big Brown Bats use sonar to take out Wax moths at high speed. And the world's 2nd fastest cat leaps 10 feet into the air after its aerial prey.When death comes to the underworld, it takes the express!

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Another rare species and close relative of manatees is the dugong. Dugongs cling to survival in a few isolated corners of the globe. In marine sanctuaries in Abu Dhabi, the bizarre animals have been notoriously difficult to find, let alone photograph. Manatees and Dugongs features exclusive HD imagery of the mammals in the wild and examines efforts of scientists to protect the two species. The program also includes thrilling captures and field exams of manatees in Florida.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As Loro Parque's head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. From tending to oversexed otters, fine-footed flamingoes or armoured armadillos, a day spent with Jorge, is a day immersed in nature from the four corners of the globe. Ever seen a grown man hug a turtle? For Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, it's all part of the job! He's hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research _ but first he's just got to locate the turtle _ 2,000 meters down in the ocean!

programme.title: Rip Files

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: In this episode we explore Las Vegas' lesser known past. We visit the National Atomic Testing museum to learn about how the desert outside of Vegas was used for testing America's secret nuclear weapons. We also visit the Mormon Fort, the first permanent non-native settlement in the area, as well as the Neon Museum.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: It's island living in the Keys on this episode of TTH. We learn about the islands treasure hunting history at the Mel Fisher Museum. Then we'll explore Fort Jefferson, an isolated fort in the Gulf of Mexico that defended the islands. American literature enthusiasts will enjoy a look at Ernest Hemingway's Key West home, where some of his most famous works were penned.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature's force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Trolling monster Chinook Salmon with Big Jim Henschke outside Port Hardy, BC!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Ranthambore National Park is part of Project Tiger, a unique wildlife conservation program set up to insure the preservation of the magnificent Tiger. In Ranthambore we encounter the tiger along with Sambar and Blue Bull, Wild Boar and Langur Monkey. We also explore the historic side of Ranthambore which is dotted with ruins of the fort that protected the region for hundreds of years. We end the episode with a tour of a very different national park. Board a rickshaw and join your guide as he explores Keoladeo National Park, known for its abundant bird life.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: India can match Africa mega-animal for mega-animal. The three biggest—elephant, buffalo and rhino are found in large numbers in only one national park in India—Kazaringa. Join Bill as he attempts to check each of these highly endangered and dangerous herbivores off his bucket list.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: To this day sisal, a rope making fiber plant, is a mainstay of the economy. Journeys tours the capital city of Tanzania and its diverse religious institutions before heading into sisal country. We'll learn about the German influences and the seldom heard story of Livingstone's final trip across Africa.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: From the streets of Soweto to the colonial Union Building, the metro area of Joburg is a mix of architecture, people and traditions. Johannesburg is more than just a big city—it's also home to one of the world's best safari parks.

programme.title: Nomads

programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.desc: Ubongo the gorilla has a foot injury, and treating a 400-pound patient takes serious skill. Meanwhile, Ester's team unveils a coral farm—less cuddly, but just as vital. programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The legendary wild dingo, the iconic kangaroos, vicious feral cats, the delightfully bizarre platypus and the unmistakably cuddly koala _ all call Australia home. Koala _ Hidden high in gum trees, the koala is one of Australia's most beloved animals. Dingo _ Sleek, agile, and descended from wolves, dingoes are Australia's top land carnivores. Kangaroo _ With powerful legs and iconic bounds, kangaroos embody the spirit of Australia. Wild Cats _ Over 12 million wild house cats roam Australia's diverse landscapes. Platypus _ Unique and mysterious, the platypus is one of Australia's most enchanting creatures.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: The tiny island nation of Tonga in the remote South Pacific is a haven for the magnificent mammals. With few natural resources or other means of income, the country is considering opening it's waters to foreign whaling fleets in exchange for hard currency. The merits and legitimacy of scientific whaling by Japan and other nations is hotly debated. The iconic species is a favorite of whale watchers from Alaska to Mexico and the stage is set for an epic battle between whalers and conservationists. Humpbacks: From Tonga to Antarctica also features Paul Watson of the Sea Shepherd Society.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: The ocean is a harsh world where survival depends on feeding and avoiding predators. Sea creatures use camouflage, bright colors, venom, and group behavior for protection. Some hide, others rely on safety in numbers. Even venomous animals must stay alert. From top predators to bottom feeders, each species has evolved unique strategies. Defense includes toxins, teeth, mimicry, and camouflage. Nudibranchs, clownfish, squid, octopus, and orcas are just a few winners in the underwater Race of Life, adapting brilliantly to their environment.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Insects may be small, but their survival strategies are fierce. They thrive in diverse environments thanks to their exoskeletons, which protect against impact, chemicals, and water. Wings help them escape danger or seek food and mates. Dragonflies hover and dart after prey, monarchs undergo stunning metamorphosis, and praying mantises blend into greenery before striking. Social insects like ants and bees live in colonies. From camouflage to flight, every adaptation helps insects stay in the Race of Life.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: The Internet began in 1969 as a Cold War military tool for secure communication. Email followed in 1972. Decades later, Tim Berners-Lee introduced the World Wide Web, linking documents and revolutionizing public access. His idea, once called "vague but exciting," reshaped how we share, protest, and connect. Now, with Web 3.0 on the horizon, the Internet may evolve to understand human needs—what's next in this digital journey?

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Early computers include the Antikythera device and Babbage's engines, though his designs were ahead of their time. WWII accelerated the need for powerful calculators. Early machines were massive but weak. The invention of the transistor in the 1950s replaced bulky vacuum tubes, enabling personal computers. Today, supercomputers help design planes, buildings—even target genes. Computers are evolving fast—what's next?

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: The Body Transfer Illusion tricks the brain into feeling ownership of a fake body part, like in the rubber hand experiment. The Autokinetic Effect makes stationary lights seem to move in darkness. The Moon Illusion causes the moon to appear larger near the horizon due to visual references. Geometric illusions distort shapes and lines through clever design. Stereoscopy lets us perceive depth by merging two flat images into one 3D view.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Animation creates motion from still images shown in rapid sequence. Aviation illusions affect pilots' balance due to conflicting sensory input. The spinning dancer illusion shows bistable perception—viewers may see it spin in either direction. Mirages occur when light bends through layers of air at different temperatures. Rainbows form when sunlight refracts and reflects through water droplets, splitting light into visible colors.

programme.desc: Poslednjih godina, mnogi su prestali da putuju, pa i Dejvid Roko. Njega i porodicu su hrana i kuvanje zbližili. Dejvid sada otvara svoj dom i poziva porodicu i prijatelje da podele svoju priču o tome šta hrana znači za njih.

programme.title: Rik Stajn: Put do Meksika
programme.desc: Rik odlazi u glavni grad koji, iako deluje usko na karti, ima čak tri vremenske zone. Zbog toga ga lokalci prosto zovu Meksiko i nije se mnogo promenio otkada je bio centar Astečkog carstva. Scene sa murala Dijega Rivere i dalje krase grad.

programme.title: Džimijevi Ukusi Floride
programme.desc: Pridružite se Džimijevom gastronomskom putu kroz sunčanu Floridu. U ovoj delom kuvarskoj emisiji, delom putopisu, Džimi se udružuje sa najpoznatijim kuvarima regije da bi spremili izvanredan asortiman jela na floridski način.

programme.title: Pecite sa Akisom
programme.desc: Kuvar Akis Petretzikis vraća se sa 10 živopisnih epizoda mediteranskih gozbi i neodoljivih deserta. Od porodičnih pečenja do rashlađenih kolača i grčkih klasika, 5. sezona donosi jednostavne, ukusne recepte za svakodnevne obroke i posebna okupljanja.

programme.title: Džejmijevi laki i jednostavni recepti
programme.desc: Ove nedelje u serijalu "Džejmijevi laki i jednostavni recepti" Džejmi sprema neverovatno jednostavne i ukusne obroke. Za početak sprema dimljeni bakalar. To je savršeno riblje jelo kada ste u žurbi. Zatim sprema azijsko jelo punog ukusa.

programme.title: Markus Vering: Priče iz kulinarske bašte
programme.desc: Markus Vering istražuje nove mogućnosti na svom imanju u Saseksu. Otkriva neke jaganjce koji žive u slanim močvarama, uči kako se uzgajaju neobična povrća i posećuje lokalnu školu.

programme.title: Izlet sa Kertisom Stounom
programme.desc: Kertis traga za inspiracijom u vinogradima, selima i obalama u jugozapadnom delu Australije. Upoznaje vlasnika ranča koji uzgaja kratkoroga goveda koja idu na ispašu. Kertis peca slatkovodne rakove.

programme.title: Izlet sa Kertisom Stounom
programme.desc: Kertis putuje u Lombardiju kako bi otkrio lokalni sir i seljačko jelo. Kreće na helikoptersko razgledanje vinograda Franćijakorta, da pokupi penušavo vino koje će upariti sa kavijarom koji se proizvodi u regiji.

programme.title: Džejmijeva čudesna jela iz jednog tiganja
programme.desc: Džejmi prikazuje čitav niz jela koja se prave u jednom tiganju. Prvo na redu je losos u kesici, zatim jednostavni uštipci iz tiganja, pečeni rolat od svinjetine i rižoto koji se pripremaju u istoj tepsiji za musaku.

programme.title: Džejmijeva čudesna jela iz jednog tiganja
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi Džejmi unapređuje pripremu obroka za radnu nedelju. Prvo pravi jednostavne i ukusne njoke, zatim ogromne, ljutkaste ćufte na brzi način i za kraj, okreće omiljeno porodično jelo naglavačke. U pitanju je prevrnuta riblja pita.

programme.title: Prelepa peciva sa Džulijet Sir
programme.desc: Džulijet se raduje zdravom početku godine, pa priprema slane mafine, proteinske štanglice od granole i neverovatnu biljnu tortu po imenu "Cacti & Succulents". Dr Randž priprema zdrave i ukusne lazanje od 5 vrsta povrća.

programme.title: Džon Torod: Bliski istok
programme.desc: Kuvar Džon Torod putuje da nađe najbolju hranu Bliskog istoka. Na putu sluša fascinantne priče meštana i sakuplja savete, trikove i tradicionalne recepte. Kuva na licu mesta sa lokalnim kuvarima i u svakoj epizodi predstavlja tri raskošna jela.

programme.title: Džon Torod: Bliski istok

programme.title: Gordon, Đino i Fred na putovanju
programme.desc: Poslednja destinacija na putovanju je Gordonova domovina Škotska. Kuvar sprema jelo za glavešinu klana Remzijevih i njihove goste. Ako obrok dobro prođe, Gordon će zvanično biti primljen u klan. Zato kuvar Remzi želi da sve bude savršeno.

programme.title: Džejmi: Sve za 20 minuta
programme.desc: Svako jelo u ovoj seriji snimljeno je u jednom kadru bez montaže, bez trikova, odvažni recepti u realnom vremenu u jednom neprekinutom kadru. Brza hrana u realnom vremenu, večera za 20 minuta ili manje tako da publika zaista može da poveruje.

programme.title: Mišel Ru na reci: Temza

programme.title: Izlet sa Kertisom Stounom
programme.desc: Vozeći se obalom auto-putem 1, Kertis pokušava da otkrije lepote Tihog okeana. Zatim posećuje par koji je od tehnike prešao na proizvodnju sira. Kertis onda odlazi u lov na morske ježeve, sa jedinim ženskim fakultetskim roniocem u Kaliforniji.

programme.title: Izlet sa Kertisom Stounom
programme.desc: Među srednjovekovnim gradovima, gustim šumama i vijugavim ulicama, Kertis juri za psima u potrazi za tartufima. Potom dobija obuku od majstora porčete. Usavršava umeće klanja golubova kako bi spremio jelo koje koristi sve delove ptice.

programme.title: Džejmijeva čudesna jela iz jednog tiganja
programme.desc: Džejmi otkriva čitav niz jela koja se mogu pripremiti u jednom tiganju. Prvo pravi piletinu sa limunskom travom, zatim batat sa čilijem i naćos čipsom, i za kraj, čokoladnu tortu sa mandarinama iz konzerve i filom od putera.

programme.title: Džejmijeva čudesna jela iz jednog tiganja
programme.desc: Džejmi danas priprema dva jela, koja su odlična za savremen, prezauzet način života. Prvo pravi šakšuku sa šparglama, brokolijem i harisom i zatim, priprema neverovatno ukusno razvučeno svinjsko meso. Ovo meso se može upotrebiti u raznim jelima.

programme.title: Donalovi pravovremeni recepti
programme.desc: Pridružite se Donalu Skijanu u novoj seriji "Donalovi pravovremeni recepti". Vreme nije na vašoj strani? Nema problema, ova serija ima rešenje! Bez mariniranja, rerne, bez zavrzlama, samo brzo kuvanje, tako da će vaša kuhinja da radi za vas.

programme.title: Odmazda
programme.desc: Ratni veteran pokušava da prikupi novac za lečenje svog sina tako što se sa još jednim veteranom udružuje u lovu na kriminalce.

programme.title: Operacija "Senka"
programme.desc: Policija u Makau vraća iz penzije vrhunskog stručnjaka za traganje kako bi pomogao u hvatanju opasne grupe profesionalnih lopova koji planiraju veliki pljačkaški poduhvat.

programme.title: Rezervoar
programme.desc: Nakon što je na tajanstven način nasledio napušteno imanje na obali, Ben i njegova porodica slučajno oslobađaju drevno biće koje je dugo bilo uspavano, a koje je generacijama terorisalo ceo region, uključujući i njegove pretke.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Skor: Mjuzikl na ledu
programme.desc: Sedamnaestogodišnji Farli je vodio bezbedan život: školovan kod kuće, jeo organsku hranu i posećivao umetničke galerije. Na zaprepašćenje svojih roditelja, Farli voli da igra hokej sa decom iz komšiluka. Stvar je dodatno zakomplikovana kada ga primeti vlasnik omladinskog tima, koji ga odmah uzima pod svoje i on postaje zvezda. Ali brzo otkriva da slava ima cenu, uključujući i očekivanje da se bori na ledu. Kad se tome doda kvarenje odnosa s najboljim prijateljem, Farli shvata da ništa ne ide kako bi trebalo.

programme.title: Izviđačka avantura
programme.desc: Film o odrastanju grupe dečaka i devojčica koji se vraćaju s kampovanja i shvataju da je njihov mali grad pod opsadom grupe prilično tupavih bajkera. Koristeći svoje izviđačko znanje, deca savladavaju članove bande, jednog po jednog.

programme.title: Ted - izgubljeni pustolov
programme.desc: Avanturista u pokušaju, Tad Džons, traži izgubljeni grad u spektakularnoj 3D komediji koja će vas prošetati od amazonske džungle do planinskih vrhova Anda.

programme.title: Operacija "Morski vuk"
programme.desc: U poslednjim danima Drugog svetskog rata, Nemačka, očajna i u potrazi za poslednjom šansom da porazi saveznike, okuplja svoje preostale podmornice za završnu misiju: napad na kontinentalne Sjedinjene Države.

programme.title: Vidimo se u septembru
programme.desc: "Vidimo se u septembru" je originalna romantična komedija, smeštena u moderni Menhetn. Film govori o Lizi, prelepoj ženi koja naizgled ima sve, ali se duboko u sebi plaši vezivanja. Kad sazna da će njen terapeut celog avgusta biti na odmoru, šokirana je i uplašena. Umesto da ovu vest prihvati smireno, ona traži pomoć od ogorčene prijateljice, Monike.

programme.title: Isterivači duhova
programme.desc: Nakon invazije duhova na Menhetn, ljubiteljke paranormalnih pojava Erin Gilbert i Ejbi Jejts, nuklearna inženjerka Džilijan Holcman i radnica podzemne železnice, Peti Tolan, zajedno se suprotstavljaju neprijatelju s drugog sveta.

programme.title: Tinejdžerka tajni agent
programme.desc: Žestoki, snalažljivi privatni detektiv, pristaje da u okviru istrage FBI bude deo tajnog zadatka unutar bratstva na koledžu.

programme.title: Obućar
programme.desc: "Kobler" govori o obućaru, četvrtoj generaciji u porodičnom poslu, koji pronalazi magičnu šivaću mašinu u podrumu svog oca. Mašina mu omogućava da živi živote svih ljudi koji nose njegove cipele.

programme.title: Klik - Za savršen život
programme.desc: Mikl Njumen, oženjeni muškarac opsednut poslom, nema vremena za svoju suprugu i decu; ne ako želi da impresionira svog nezahvalnog šefa i dobije zasluženo unapređenje. Kada upozna Mortija, luckastog prodavca, dobija odgovor na svoje molitve: magični daljinski upravljač koji mu omogućava da preskoči sitne životne smetnje, uz urnebesne posledice.

programme.title: STANICA BROJEVA
programme.desc: Iskusni tajni agent dobija lošu psihološku procenu nakon poslednje misije i privremeno biva sklonjen sa terena. Njegov novi zadatak deluje jednostavno: da štiti mladu radijsku spikerku i udaljenu stanicu u kojoj radi. Međutim, nakon iznenadnog napada, rutinski zadatak prerasta u očajničku borbu za život.

programme.title: Prošli život
programme.desc: Kada nezaposlenog novinara hipnotišu tokom seanse regresije u prošli život, on ne otkriva da je nekada bio kralj ili neka druga slavna ličnost, već počinju da ga progone sećanja serijskog ubice.

programme.title: Oči zmaja
programme.desc: Sent Džud je kraj koji živi u strahu i očajanju. Rivalske bande lokalnih dilera Daša i Antoana terorišu ulice i građani žive bez trunke nade, sve dok u grad ne stigne tajanstveni stranac, Rajan Hong (Cung Le). Ubrzo počinje da zavađa dve bande, a u sukobu s njima koristi svoje neverovatne borilačke veštine, koje je naučio od svog briljantnog mentora Tijana (Žan-Klod Van Dam). Ali, baš kada je počeo da pomaže zajednici, Hong upoznaje gospodina V. Isprva je gospodin V oduševljen Hongovim veštinama, ali ubrzo shvata da je on pretnja njegovom poretku, pa počinje borba ove dvojice ratnika. S jedne strane su strah i korumpiranost sistema gospodina V, a s druge novi početak koji Hong donosi stanovnicima Sent Džuda.

programme.title: Igra žrtvovanja
programme.desc: Kao da već nije dovoljno loše to što učenice internata, Samanta i Klara, ne mogu da odu kući za praznike, situacija se dodatno komplikuje kada se na njihovim vratima pojavi banda ubica baš u vreme Božića.

programme.title: Đavolje trojstvo
programme.desc: U burnoj Montani 1870-ih, osuđenik Ajzak Brodvej pred pogubljenje poverava otuđenom sinu Henriju nemoguć zadatak: da ubije čoveka koji ga je lažno optužio. Henrijeva potraga vodi ga u zabačeni gradić Triniti, gde se nalazi između pravednog šerifa Gabrijela Dava i tajanstvenog stranca po imenu Sent Kristofer.

programme.title: Nasmejano lice
programme.desc: Nakon što mlada glumica nesvesno pojede kolačiće s marihuanom, njen dan pretvara se u niz sumanutih avantura.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Čarobnjak i bela zmija
programme.desc: Ching Siu-Tung režira film zasnovan na kineskoj legendi o travaru koji se zaljubljuje u Belu Zmiju staru hiljadu godina, prerušenu u ženu. Jet Li glumi čarobnjaka koji otkriva pravi identitet zmije i započinje borbu za dušu muškarca.

programme.title: Maraton
programme.desc: Mladi službenik Jusuf predlaže četvorici kolega iz firme da učestvuju na maratonu i pronalazi sponzora. Oni pristaju, pa Jusuf postaje njihov trener. Ispostavlja se da je čitav trening klatak cirkus. Fizičko stanje muškaraca, koji su pušači, pijandure, žderači slatkiša i kockari, zaista je užasno. Uz to, ni situacija kod kuće nije im baš zavidna, jer svako ima svoje probleme. Uprkos inspirativnim treninzima trenera Jusufa, oni naizgled ne mogu da prate njegov gust raspored. Prvi test, trka u Amsterdamu, pretvara se u katastrofu. Nakon Jusufove kritike, momci postaju uporni, pa čak i fanatični. Ipak, tokom priprema za maraton, postaje jasno da je ulog mnogo veći od spasavanja garaže, kako im je rečeno.

programme.title: Penina senka
programme.desc: Tokom odmora na ostrvu Ejmland, devojka otkriva opasnog konja koji nema poverenja u ljude. Da bi dokazala da konj uopšte nije opasan, devojka ga potajno obučava kako bi ponovo stekao poverenje u ljude.

programme.title: Deca špijuni: Sve vreme sveta
programme.desc: Novopečena penzionisana agentkinja Džesika Vilson pokušava da se prilagodi porodičnom životu, ali su joj kućni poslovi teži od bilo kakve misije. Kada porodična amajlija slučajno oslobodi opasnog Čuvara Vremena, Džesika se vraća u akciju, a deca Sesil i Rebeka, uz pomoć starih Špijunčića, postaju jedina nada za spas porodice i čitavog sveta.

programme.title: Nas dvojica
programme.desc: Žan Hristian Ranu (Daniel Auteuil) je malo ekscentričan knjigovođa koji živi dan za danom. Žil Gabriel (Alain Chabat) je pop pevač koji je već imao svojih pet minuta slave. Niko ne bi ni pomislio da živote ta dva potpuno različita muškarca mogu da se povežu. Pop zvezda se sprema za svoj veliki povratak na scenu. Ipak, njegovi planovi se remete kada ga Ranu udari kolima. Kad Ranu dolazi sebi, otkriva da u glavi ima neki drugi glas. Uspostavlja se da je Gabrijel preminuo i nekako ušao u telo knjigovođe. Od tog trenutka, Ranu postaje dve osobe u jednom telu…

programme.title: Isterivači duhova: Nasleđe
programme.desc: Kada samohrana majka sa dvoje dece stigne u mali grad, zajedno počinju da otkrivaju svoju povezanost sa originalnim Isterivačima duhova, kao i tajnu zaostavštinu njihovog dede.

programme.title: Marmelada
programme.desc: Baron, an imprisoned man, strikes up a friendship with cellmate Otis. As the pair hatch an escape plan together, Baron recalls the story of how he met Marmalade, the love of his life, and their Bonnie and Clyde scheme to rob a bank in order to care for his sick mother and give the couple the life they've always dreamed of.

programme.title: Ljubav u oblacima
programme.desc: Novinarka Bruklin odlazi na Festival balona da upozna pilota Džareda, koji organizuje romantične letove, iako nije baš spreman za ljubav.

programme.title: Čarlijevi anđeli
programme.desc: Tri zanosne agentkinje, vešte u prerušavanju, špijunaži i borilačkim veštinama, vraćaju se u akciju! Kada ih zločinački genije uvuče u zaveru koja preti da ukine pravo na privatnost, Anđeli uz pomoć vernog Boslija kreću da ga zaustave. Ali otkriće strašne tajne pretvara ih u mete ubica.

programme.title: Humanitarni biro
programme.desc: U bliskoj budućnosti naša vlada odlučivaće o tome ko je potrošna roba.

programme.title: Fatalni izgled
programme.desc: Priča o tinejdžeru koji se nosi s manama i prednostima svoje smrtonosne privlačnosti.

programme.title: Noćas nećeš spavati
programme.desc: Dečaka progone zastrašujuće noćne more u kojima se čudovište krije u ormaru. Na njegovo olakšanje, otac se pojavljuje usred noći kako bi mu pomogao da se suoči sa svojim strahovima. Ali dečak počinje da preispituje pravu prirodu tih prikaza, primoran da se suoči sa istinom o sudbini svog oca i zloj sili koja preti da ga obuzme.

programme.title: Noćas nećeš spavati
programme.desc: Dečaka progone zastrašujuće noćne more u kojima se čudovište krije u ormaru. Na njegovo olakšanje, otac se pojavljuje usred noći kako bi mu pomogao da se suoči sa svojim strahovima. Ali dečak počinje da preispituje pravu prirodu tih prikaza, primoran da se suoči sa istinom o sudbini svog oca i zloj sili koja preti da ga obuzme.

programme.title: Londonski bulevar
programme.desc: Priča o londonskom kriminalcu koji izlazi iz zatvora i započinje vezu s mladom povučenom glumicom.

programme.title: Dezerter
programme.desc: Neočekivano prijateljstvo u konfuznoj i haotičnoj situaciji. Sajmon Mari bori se za francusku Legiju stranaca. Paskal Dipon bori se samo za sebe. Ljudi u ratu preispituju čast, nadu i moral. Jer, od svega se može pobeći, osim od sebe.

programme.title: Knjiga od krvi
programme.desc: Stručnjak za paranormalno otkriva kuću na raskršću takozvanih "autoputeva", kojima se duše transportuju na onaj svet.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Izviđačka avantura
programme.desc: Film o odrastanju grupe dečaka i devojčica koji se vraćaju s kampovanja i shvataju da je njihov mali grad pod opsadom grupe prilično tupavih bajkera. Koristeći svoje izviđačko znanje, deca savladavaju članove bande, jednog po jednog.

programme.title: Pas Timber - Lovac na blago
programme.desc: Dečak i njegov najbolji prijatelj (preslatki pas koji govori), daju sve od sebe da sačuvaju svoj dom i porodicu.

programme.title: Projekat Dinosaur
programme.desc: Projekat "Dinosaurus" govori o ekspediciji oca i sina u Kongu, uz pratnju dokumentarističke TV ekipe. Kada svi akteri filma misteriozno nestanu, pronađeni snimak pokazaće zapanjujuće prizore dinosaurusa, za koje se verovalo da su izumrli pre 65 miliona godina.

programme.title: Kancelarija na ćošku
programme.desc: U ovoj komediji o kancelarijskom životu, savesni službenik Orson pronalazi utočište u praznoj kancelariji, daleko od napornih kolega. Međutim, njegov neobičan izbor izaziva neočekivano negodovanje i pokreće niz apsurdnih događaja.

programme.title: Reči
programme.desc: Pisac se suočava s mračnom tajnom.

programme.title: Legenda o Zorou
programme.desc: Iako pokušava da ostavi viteške pustolovine iza sebe, pretnja po Kaliforniju, državu u nastajanju, primorava Dona Alehandra de la Vegu i njegovu suprugu Elenu da ponovo stupe u akciju.

programme.title: Praktične devojke
programme.desc: Dve bogate sestre, naslednice porodičnog kozmetičkog carstva, suočavaju se sa surovom realnošću kada ih skandal i istraga ostave bez nasledstva.

programme.title: Zvezda za Božić
programme.desc: Rajli je umetnički direktor Onota teatra. Kada Redžina, vlasnica teatra, najavi prodaju prostora za Božić, Rajli angažuje njenog sestrića, TV zvezdu Sema Kembela, za ulogu Boba Kračeta u "Božićnoj priči" kako bi iskoristila njegovu slavu i ubedila je da odustane od prodaje.

programme.title: Postanje
programme.desc: Engleski prirodnjak Čarls Darvin pokušava da pronađe ravnotežu između svojih revolucionarnih teorija o evoluciji i odnosa s religioznom suprugom, čija je vera u apsolutnoj suprotnosti s njegovim životnim delom.

programme.title: Udovice
programme.desc: "Udovice" je priča o četiri žene koje nemaju ništa zajedničko osim ogromnih dugova koje su, nakon života praćenog kriminalnim aktivnostima, njihovi pokojni muževi ostavili za sobom. U modernom Čikagu, situacija se komplikuje kada Veronika (Viola Dejvis), Alisa (Elizabet Debiki), Linda (Mišel Rodrigez) i Bela (Sintija Erivo) uzmu sudbinu u svoje ruke, rešene da budućnost skroje prema sopstvenoj zamisli.

programme.title: Na pogrešnom putu
programme.desc: Četvorica mladića upuštaju se u rizičnu investiciju, koja ih vodi u sukob s mafijom.

programme.title: Ponoć u plavoj travi
programme.desc: FBI agent i savezni policajac iz Floride udružuju se kako bi istražili niz nerešenih ubistava.

programme.title: Gotam: Pad i uspon Njujorka
programme.desc: Transformacija i oživljavanje Njujorka jedna je od najzanimljivijih priča u istoriji urbanizma. Njujork je bio grad u propadanju, koji je do 1990. godine beležio više od 2.200 ubistava, 93.000 nasilnih pljački i 147.000 krađa automobila godišnje, uz opadanje srednje klase, niske vrednosti nekretnina i poražavajuće niske rezultate u obrazovanju. Međutim, tada se dogodilo nešto posebno. To nije bio rezultat šireg društvenog ili ekonomskog pokreta, već intelektualne promene i revolucije koja se desila zahvaljujući političkom vođstvu, novom pristupu upravljanju i preispitivanju, te promeni ustaljenih tradicija na lokalnom nivou. Kako se bliži 400. godišnjica Njujorka u 2024. godini, saznajemo šta stoji iza Pada i Uspona Njujorka.

programme.title: Pakao na točkovima: najsmrtonosniji putevi na svetu
programme.desc: Godine 2020, više od 1,35 miliona ljudi izgubilo je život u saobraćajnim nesrećama širom sveta, dok je više od 50 miliona povređeno. To znači da u proseku svakog dana u saobraćajnim nesrećama pogine oko 3.700 ljudi — što je ekvivalent sedam velikih avionskih nesreća dnevno. Bilo da ste u Aziji, Evropi, Americi, Africi ili Okeaniji, uvek igrate lutriju, rizikujući da postanete žrtva saobraćajne nesreće. Niko nije zaista imun: ako ste na putu, u opasnosti ste. Otkrijte sve o globalnoj epidemiji saobraćajnih nesreća u napetoj trodelnoj dokumentarnoj seriji "Pakao na točkovima: najsmrtonosniji putevi na svetu". Svaka 52-minutna epizoda vas vodi na putovanje visokog napona, uz hrabre muškarce i žene koji su na prvim linijama ovih tragedija — vatrogasce, policajce, vozače šlep službi, ili novinare, koji neretko prvi stižu na mesto nesreće. Čućemo svedočenja žrtava i analize saobraćajnih stručnjaka, dok uz pomoć detaljnih 3D prikaza i šokantnih snimaka sa mesta događaja rekonstruišemo trenutak sudara. Ova serija donosi potresnu i poučnu istragu o najsmrtonosnijim putevima sveta, podsećajući nas da svako, bilo gde, može biti sledeći.

programme.title: Hitler: Nemačka kobna privlačnost
programme.desc: Na početku 20. veka, Evropa je u pokretu, što dovodi do savršenih uslova za osnivanje jedne od najstrašnijih političkih organizacija u istoriji, Nacističke partije. Kako to da su uspeli da zavedu čitavu Nemačku? Da li je čitava nacija bila očarana Nacističkom partijom ili je nada u bolji život propala čim su krenuli s prvim ubistvima? Odgovaramo na ta pitanja dok pratimo rođenje, uspon i konačni krah Hitlera i Nacističke partije.

programme.title: Naučne minijature
programme.desc: "Naučne minijature" je zabavna i intrigantna naučna serija koja testira znanje gledalaca o različitim naučnim temama. Privlači gledaoce iznenađujućim činjenicama, brzim kvizovima i zanimljivim mišljenjima. "Naučne minijature" koristi šest stručnjaka koji nas vode kroz različite oblasti kao što su životinje, svemir i planete.

programme.title: Naučne minijature

"Naučne minijature" koristi šest stručnjaka koji nas vode kroz različite oblasti kao što su životinje, svemir i planete.
